name: Heartache 101 ~Sour into Sweet~
source: Assuming the role of a male high school student in Japan, the player will meet, interact with, and date a number of female characters with the goal of winding up with one of them at the end of a 101-day calendar.
translation: 玩家扮演一名日本男高中生，在101天的日程中结识、互动并约会多名女性角色，目标是在最后与其中一人走到一起。
